Portable test suite for modular services, designed to be usable with other service managers and use cases, inside Nixpkgs and externally.

Like modular services itself, it's still quite bare-bones. New features can crystallize around this kind of infrastructure.

Assisted-By: Claude Opus 4.7/4.8 era Claude models
